summary: Cataloged 26 game projects under C:\Users\Alex\Projects (skipped qualiacology site repos and zips; you-are-here is not currently present under Projects). Top donors for FETCH, in order: (1) THE EATEN PATH — the forest game: Flora billboard-tree generation, landmark prop builders (cemetery/deadwood/snag-figure/junk-that-switches-on), the single-class VHS post pass (src/vhs.js:102), HRTF prop audio (src/audio.js:301) and figure-down-the-path scare direction — this alone covers 'forests + horror atmosphere + audio'. (2) UNINVITED + BLACKTHORN MANOR — the shared house-horror engine: NPC wander/speech AI (uninvited/src/npc.js), the mundane-misread scare library (scares.js), procedural textures and the candle/grey-lady effects stack. (3) THE LAG — the PoseBuffer ring buffer (double.js:66) that turns the player's own recorded poses into a monster, plus reverb-tail-grows-with-danger audio: both are cheap, high-concept horror systems that fit a skull-away-from-hand game. (4) CINDERBLOOM — the looks donor: 4-class procedural creature rigs + Enemies AI (game/enemies.js), encounter Director, and the volumetrics/gtao/grade post stack that would upgrade skull-as-light. (5) KICK BALL — the ball-feel ancestor: FEEL_PROFILE at game.js:33, catch-launch traversal, and tests/cadence.mjs — the right harness pattern to fence FETCH's feel core during the Codex merge. Audio standouts elsewhere: GOODFIRE's wind-you-fight-by-ear (audio.js:316), EVENSONG's formant choir for wordless ghost voices, CHAMBER's tension-driven heartbeat, RALLY's 'music lives only while the ball is alive' rule which maps directly onto skull-out/skull-caught. Everything else (bullet hells, platformers, toys) is niche: pooling from FINALE, decoupled-tip trail from SUMI, reaching-hands imagery from LIFT, portrait generation from LONELY HAUNTER, tactile foley from CANDY MACHINE.
